questions.question:
**A sentence with an underlined word is given below. Select the most appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

Kicking her dog when she was down was very __callous__ of Amanda.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. compassionate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__:- **

The sentence talks about Amanda's mean and uncaring behaviour, that is, kicking her own dog, because she was upset. 

 
• Callous: Uncaring, unfeeling, and unnecessarily mean behaviour. (लापरवाह, असंवेदनशील, और अनावश्यक रूप से मतलबी व्यवहार)
 
• Compassionate: Feeling of showing sympathy and concern for others; caring. (दूसरों के लिए सहानुभूति और चिंता दिखाने की भावना; देखभाल0

Thus, it is clear that 'callous' and 'compassionate' are antonyms.

Let's look at the meanings of the other words:

 
• Heartless: A complete lack of feeling or consideration for someone. (किसी के लिए भावना या विचार का पूर्ण अभाव)
 
• Diligent: Being very careful and hard-working in any duty or work that one does. (किसी भी कर्तव्य या काम में बहुत सावधान और मेहनती होना जो कोई करता है)
 
• Insolent: Rude and arrogant. (असभ्य और अभिमानी)

questions.question:
**Choose the word which is nearly opposite in meaning to the given word:-**

Purgatory
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/atKwIxseTD8vRnVUC3oGdufIwU5EBz_2UC-92UEVtdPyAGB6prbAzPqN26KeQtY4RGQbInj_lgEwglneUFSzumGRkMOAaDYEiH75HI-PcLJjxKytS0NzQ7314zrpphHdCdZ-fL2D] Explanation **

The correct answer is option 2 i.e. celestial.

 

 
• Purgatory refers to a place or state of temporary suffering or misery.
 
• It is a place or state of punishment wherein the souls of those who die may make satisfaction for past sins and so become fit for heaven​.

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/RBX06wZK99HfURprNWYSlpAzWykJH-PrBkH3j9VjtKKCiJ9fVxOkfYzF7h_fAAN2SBYsfJq9FlKe49c11pYP5F1GWbIJxRic3PPTp-NhXVyLmbOeV0xkPjNr3bY9yasE08KzfYJm] ​

Let us take a look at what the options mean:​

 
• Reward: a thing given in recognition of service, effort, or achievement.
 
• Celestial**: belonging or relating to heaven.
 
• Flawless: without any imperfections or defects.
 
• Proximity: nearness in space, time, or relationship.

 

From the above words, it is clear that 'purgatory' is opposite to 'celestial;' since purgatory refers to a more harsh form suffering, most likely synonymous to 'hell' based on it's origins. Meanwhile, 'celestial' is a more belonging and nicer, referring to heavenly places.

 

Therefore **'celestial'** is opposite to the word '**purgatory**'
